name: FXQuotation
description: An FX rate quotation obtained by SVC-010 (International Payments, CAP-003) from the bank's FX pricing engine for a cross-currency international transfer. Created in PH-030. One or more FXQuotation records may exist per InternationalTransfer (when quotes lapse and are refreshed), but only one may have status = accepted at any time. The accepted FXQuotation locks in the exchange rate for the BusinessAccount debit and FATF travel rule GBP equivalent reporting. Not created for GBP-denominated transfers. Introduced by JRN-009.
owning_capability: CAP-003 (Payment Operations — International Payments, promoted sub-capability CAP-003.04)

fields.name: sell_currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code. For UK corporate transfers, always GBP. Immutable.

fields.name: buy_currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code. Must equal InternationalTransfer.currency. Immutable.

fields.name: rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal. 6 decimal places. All-in rate inclusive of FX margin. GBP per 1 unit of buy_currency. Immutable after status = accepted.

fields.name: validity_seconds
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive integer. Duration in seconds for which the rate is guaranteed. Minimum 30 for large amounts (> £1M); minimum 120 for standard amounts. The quote expires at created_at + validity_seconds.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending_acceptance | accepted | lapsed | cancelled. Transitions: pending_acceptance → accepted (customer accepts within validity window); pending_acceptance → lapsed (validity_seconds exceeded); accepted → cancelled (transfer cancelled after FX acceptance).

fields.name: quoted_gbp_equivalent
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 dp. InternationalTransfer.amount / rate. GBP cost of the transfer at this quote rate. Immutable.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable. Quote expires at created_at + validity_seconds.

fields.name: accepted_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status transitions to accepted. Must be <= created_at + validity_seconds.

relationships.description: FXQuotation belongs to one InternationalTransfer via transfer_id.

design_decisions.decision: FXQuotation is a separate entity from InternationalTransfer rather than inline FX fields on the transfer record.
design_decisions.rationale: A transfer may generate multiple quotations (lapse-refresh cycle). A dedicated entity with its own lifecycle (status, validity window, created_at) cleanly models the quotation lifecycle. The accepted quotation's rate is denormalised onto InternationalTransfer.fx_rate for downstream calculations.
